title: Design QA polish across the four apps (orchestrator review of Wave B screenshots)
story: As the sponsor I want the redesigned apps to feel consistent and correct in every detail so that nothing in the demo looks unfinished
acceptance: Fonts: the tenant brand font (e.g. Georgia for Aurelia Mutual) applies only to the brand mark and tenant name; page titles, the demo bar and all controls use the product UI font (--fx-font-ui); the demo bar selects never render in a serif fallback (screenshots before/after for Aurelia)
Identity shown once: when the demo bar is present the shell user menu shows the persona and the demo bar does not repeat the name and avatar (or vice versa); decide in design-system.md

Adjuster inbox timers agree with the claim view: the inbox regulatory timer column shows the next open timer (e.g. Contact: 2d 23h left) from the same source the claim view uses, and the Due today and Overdue tiles count from it; today every row says No timer while the claim view shows live timers (fix the projection or query in src/modules/adjuster, with a unit test)

AI summary card: dates through format.js (no raw 2026-03-30), the debug line Facts used: lossType=... is removed or moved into a collapsed Details section, provider/model/confidence/explanation stay visible
Regenerate screenshots docs/design/screens/adjuster-inbox, adjuster-claim, demo-bar and kitchen-sink-light; the reviewer opens them; full npm test no new failures
brief: Orchestrator design review of Wave B found these issues in docs/design/screens/adjuster-*.png, admin-*.png, csr-*.png, claimant-question.png. Do not edit src/web/claimant, csr or admin (they inherit the shared font fix), src/server.mjs or test harness files (S6-PLT-01 runs in parallel).

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met; 114/114 scoped tests pass; full npm test has no new failures (only baseline TODOs); screenshots verified
